mapper.select: SELECT (to_jsonb(i)||jsonb_build_object('dish',jsonb_build_object('id',d.id,'name',d.name,'image_url',d.image_url)))::text FROM meal_order_items i JOIN dishes d ON d.id=i.dish_id JOIN meal_orders o ON o.id=i.meal_order_id WHERE o.family_id=#{family} AND i.meal_order_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.sort_order,i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO meal_order_items(meal_order_id,dish_id,quantity,note,sort_order) VALUES
(#{order},#{item.dish_id},#{item.quantity},#{item.note},CASE WHEN #{item.sort_order}=0 THEN #{index} ELSE #{item.sort_order} END)
